en_before: A blazer or cropped jacket can make Bermudas feel more polished. Check the dress code before wearing shorts to work. If both the jacket and shorts are roomy, try a simple top and a smaller bag, then check where the hems fall. Our women’s tops guide compares several silhouettes.
